description: Tsaklis, Iasonas and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. Trained data-driven models predict selected operational variables and damage-equivalent loads for the IEA 3.4 MW reference turbine using HAWC2 aeroelastic simulations. Input/output scalers accompany the trained models to preserve preprocessing and inverse transformations. The separately deposited ANN/GPR/random-forest development workflow is explicitly linked by native relations and grouped as training software. These are lightweight response approximations, not replacements validated for arbitrary turbine designs or operating envelopes beyond the source training scope. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
